implementation: AWS Nitro Card Security Engine Firmware
description: The Cryptographic Module (CM) is a multi-chip standalone firmware-hybrid module. The cryptographic services provided by the module are: Data encryption / decryption utilizing symmetric ciphers, i.e. AES algorithms, Computation of hash values, i.e. SHA-256 and SHA-512 and Message authentication utilizing HMAC-SHA256, HMAC-SHA512
